title: Software Project Management (Intermediate)

assessmentData.title: Software Project Management (Intermediate)
assessmentData.description: Assesses the ability to manage software projects by analyzing lifecycle phases, applying methodologies like Agile or Waterfall, and addressing risks with effective strategies.

learningObjectives: Analyze the key phases of the software project lifecycle and their interdependencies
Apply project management methodologies such as Agile or Waterfall to software development projects
Evaluate risk management strategies to identify and mitigate potential project risks
Develop project schedules using tools like Gantt charts or project management software
Monitor and assess project progress using performance metrics and reporting techniques

title: Agile Project Management (Advanced)

assessmentData.title: Agile Project Management (Advanced)
assessmentData.description: Advanced assessment covering Agile methodologies, Scrum practices, and iterative development approaches for experienced project managers.
assessmentData.additionalInformation: Focus on Scrum methodology and sprint planning

learningObjectives: Apply Scrum framework principles and practices effectively
Facilitate sprint planning and retrospective meetings
Manage product backlogs and user stories efficiently
Implement continuous integration and delivery practices
Lead cross-functional agile teams through iterative development cycles

title: Understanding the Akara OneTouch Digital Customer Experience

assessmentData.title: Understanding the Akara OneTouch Digital Customer Experience
assessmentData.description: This benchmark evaluates your ability to navigate and support the Akara OneTouch Digital Customer Experience. It measures your understanding of key features, benefits, and service distinctions while testing your skills in addressing customer inquiries, troubleshooting issues, and determining appropriate escalation paths. Demonstrating proficiency ensures you can deliver seamless and effective digital support.
assessmentData.additionalInformation: This assessment evaluates frontline Customer Service Agents on their ability to promote the OneTouch Digital Customer Experience positively, handle customer inquiries, troubleshoot issues, and make escalation decisions regarding the Akara Digital Customer Experience. It consists of 8 questions, provides instant feedback, and is accessible on mobile devices

learningObjectives: Understand the Akara OneTouch Digital Customer Experience, including its key features and customer benefits
Distinguish between self‑service actions and agent‑assisted support within the OneTouch platform
Apply appropriate responses to common customer inquiries using approved Akara messaging
Determine when issues require escalation to specialized support
